description: Predict a load failure before it happens: for every column, the typed class its values belong to, how many values would fail a strict cast, the exact rows and values that fail, and the format traps that break typed imports - leading zeros, currency symbols, percentages, thousands separators and mixed date formats. Choose this when a CSV is about to be loaded into a typed table and you want every value that would be rejected or silently changed, with the row numbers, plus the format traps that cause most import failures. Do not choose this when the file needs cleaning or the bad values rewritten (use csv-clean), or when you want a statistical profile of each column (use csv-column-profile). Example requests: Will this CSV load into a typed table without failures? | Which rows in this CSV will break my numeric import? | Why does my CSV import turn '007' into 7?

content.description: The customer's input.csv, as text. Supported: CSV, TSV or any delimiter-separated text. Maximum 1048576 bytes.
